translations.web: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
translations.bsb: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
translations.kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
translations.asv: They are of the world: therefore speak they as of the world, and the world heareth them.
